# Michał Stężały — Senior Graphic Designer

> Visual communication design for sport, events and business.

## About

14+ years of experience. Based in Katowice, Silesia, Poland. Works remote and hybrid. Engagement models: B2B, employment contract (UoP), project-based.

## Specializations

- Sport branding
- Event branding
- Social media systems
- Sponsorship decks
- Visual identity
- Print
- AI-augmented workflow

## Notable clients

International Biathlon Union (IBU), SPORTFIVE, Stadion Śląski, GKS Katowice, Polish Biathlon Association (PZBiath), Węglokoks.
